svg.desc: Task, execution and data flow; not a security isolation boundary. How DSB works / Delegate once. Verify each step. Keep risky decisions yours. / You / Delegate / DSB app / Web UI / floating ball / Task bridge / ledger / task_id: idempotent; can stop / Unknown after restart: refuse / Brain: dsh + DeepSeek / Vision-capable / May read full frames / text / Execution primitives / agent/ / look / Frame + tree / OCR / Issue shot_id / Execution gates G1–G5 / G1 credential · G2/G2b risk / OCR / vision / G3 edges · G4 breaker · G5 audit · R3 recheck / Gate vision checks / localization: crops only / tap / swipe / type / Dispatch only if allowed / App accessibility service / Targeted display: gestures / input / Background virtual display / scrcpy · third-party apps · main screen free / Audit log / Allow / refuse reasons; local frames / Brain, gates and credentials share one Linux user; a compromised brain can bypass gates. / Unavailable OCR refuses; a failed vision service can fall back to OCR-only approval, with miss risks. / Ask DSH provides full frames, tree text and notifications; API mode uploads full frames to DeepSeek. / Control-plane cutover is pending; self-install TCP 5037 exposure is detailed in the README / threat model.
